mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend policy

No current decision on the TLS backend is recorded for this project. The recorded decisions do not settle which TLS implementation to use: an earlier selection for cryptographic operations was reopened for reconsideration without a resolution being recorded. The only current recorded decision touching TLS is that HTTPS is required for all services, with no plaintext exceptions. That decision does not name a backend. Until a backend decision is recorded, this document specifies none.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
